bank_name: Global Islami Bank PLC (formerly NRB Global Bank Limited)
period_note: Unaudited interim financial statements 'As at 30 June 2025', on the same fully-restated basis as 2025_Q1.json (its own '31 December 2024' comparative again matches the audited 2024_Q4.json exactly). Equity deepened further and even more dramatically this quarter: from -28,904.26m (Mar-2025) to -37,847.30m (Jun-2025), a single-quarter net loss of -8,943.05m -- now exceeding the entire FY2024 audited annual loss (-12,466.18m) in size on its own, in one quarter. Total Shareholders' Equity is reported here as a calculated_from_components figure (paid-up capital 9,874,396,880 + statutory reserve 2,020,644,859 + retained earnings -49,742,343,563 = -37,847,301,824) rather than this filing's own directly-printed Balance Sheet cell (-37,841,301,824, an apparent ~6-million-Taka transcription slip in the source document): the calculated figure is preferred because it independently reconciles exactly, to the Taka, with both (a) this filing's own P&L retained-earnings roll-forward (opening -33,387,401,030 + this period's cumulative PAT of -16,354,942,533 = -49,742,343,563) and (b) the quarter-over-quarter equity roll-forward from 2025_Q1.json (-28,904,256,020 + this quarter's own discrete PAT of -8,943,045,804 = -37,847,301,824 exactly) -- three independent paths agreeing, versus the single Balance Sheet cell that doesn't. Investment income collapsed to just 325.47m for the discrete quarter alone (from Q1's 3,270.13m), while profit paid on deposits continued rising -- the earning-asset base has now largely stopped generating income while funding costs continue, consistent with the bank's FY2024-disclosed 90.72% non-performing investment ratio deteriorating further. Cumulative Jan-Jun 2025 figures are the primary dataset values; the discrete Apr-Jun 2025 quarter is separately recorded. Source PDF's P&L page used the same corrupted-digit rendering seen in other 2023-2025 filings; all figures were extracted via OCR and cross-validated via the full internal arithmetic chain (including several single-character OCR misreads of '5' as '$' or '§', resolved by the arithmetic and noted here for anyone re-deriving from the source).
